name: EcoFlow DELTA 2 Portable Power Station
summary: A 1024 Wh LiFePO4 station with 1800 W rated AC output for a measured blackout load plan. Solar panels and extra batteries are not established as part of this offer.
description: DELTA 2 suits a plan built around selected lights, communications and compatible appliances rather than every circuit in a home. Its six North American AC outlets share one output budget. Prioritize the devices you need, account for startup demand and plan recharging before the battery is depleted. This profile concerns the original DELTA 2, not DELTA 2 Max, an extra battery, DELTA 3 or DELTA Pro.

specs.label: Rated AC output
specs.value: 1800 W total across six North American outlets; 2700 W surge

specs.label: USB outputs
specs.value: Two USB-C ports up to 100 W each; two USB-A 12 W and two USB-A fast-charge 18 W ports

specs.label: Solar input
specs.value: 11–60 V, 15 A, 500 W maximum; verify panel open-circuit voltage and cable compatibility

specs.label: AC charging
specs.value: 1200 W maximum; regional AC input specification 100–120 V, 50/60 Hz

specs.label: Other charging
specs.value: 12/24 V vehicle charging supported; charging cable sold separately in the current manufacturer manual

specs.label: Manufacturer box list — not verified Amazon contents
specs.value: Station, AC charging cable, manual and warranty card; solar panels and solar cable excluded in the manual

pros: Six AC sockets and dedicated USB outputs allow separate charging tasks within the documented limits.
AC, compatible solar and vehicle charging provide different replenishment options.
cons: 1800 W is shared across AC outlets; motor startup or combined loads can overload the station.
X-Boost compatibility is limited and does not increase the continuous rated output.
A solar panel, solar cable and extra battery are not established as included in this ASIN.
useCases: Schedule charging for phones, a radio and task lighting during an outage.
Compare a specific appliance’s running and startup demand with the station’s ratings before using it at camp or at home.

safetyNotes: Keep the station dry, ventilated and away from heat, flames and children. Do not cover cooling openings, open the housing or use damaged batteries or cables.

Check the delivered electrical label and manual for Canadian voltage and operating limits. Never backfeed a household wall outlet; building connections require appropriate transfer equipment and a qualified electrician.

Treat a portable battery as a limited supply, not guaranteed whole-home backup or a life-support power source. Stored Wh are not usable AC Wh; load, inverter losses, temperature and settings affect runtime.
The manual describes a non-zero EPS changeover, not an uninterrupted supply for medical emergency equipment or devices requiring zero interruption. Check timeout settings for intermittent loads.

Follow the manual’s storage charge and periodic maintenance schedule; keep the battery cool and dry. Solar panels and the solar-to-XT60/XT60i cable are excluded from the manufacturer manual’s box list.
